name: Grass Master
desc:
Win %d matches with a deck of only Grass type Pokemon
• Deck MUST contain at least 4 different Pokemon (with different names)
• Deck CANNOT contain any other Pokemon types (including Colorless Pokemon)
• Deck CAN contain any Energy cards
• Pokemon attack requirements do not matter
